title: Pure Symphonic Warrior
summary: Pure Symphonic Warrior WIND Machine Pendulum and Synchro deck centered on acoustic musicians that alter their own Levels, Types, and Attributes. Powered by Symph Amplifire and modern 2022 Pendulum support, the deck builds massive counter reserves to banish opposing cards while laddering into versatile Synchros.

summary.title: Starters
points: Symphonic Warrior Guitaar discards 1 card while in the Pendulum Zone to Special Summon any Symphonic Warrior monster directly from your Deck, and revives a Symphonic Warrior on Normal Summon.
Symphonic Warrior DJJ flips a face-down Symphonic Warrior monster face-up, and Special Summons itself from the Pendulum Zone whenever a Symphonic Warrior card or effect is activated.

Symph Amplifire places 1 Symphonic Counter each time a Symphonic Warrior card's effect is activated; removes 5 counters to burn for 300 damage per Symphonic card, or removes 7 to banish cards from the opponent's field and GY.
Symphonic Warrior Synthess searches any Symphonic Warrior monster from your Deck when flipped face-up, and can banish a Symphonic Warrior from the GY to copy its name and effects.
Symphonic Warrior Guitariss is a Level 3 Tuner that Special Summons itself from hand while Symph Amplifire is on the field, and returns a Symphonic Warrior from your Pendulum Zone to hand.

summary.title: Opening: Symphonic Warrior Guitaar + Any Discard
steps: Place Symphonic Warrior Guitaar in your Pendulum Zone.
Activate Guitaar's Pendulum effect, discarding a card to Special Summon Symphonic Warrior DJJ in face-up Defense Position.
Activate DJJ's effect to Special Summon Symphonic Warrior Synthess from your Deck in face-down Defense Position, then flip it face-up to search Symph Amplifire.
Activate Symph Amplifire to begin accumulating Symphonic Counters on every resolution.
Synchro Summon Symphonic Warrior Rockks using Guitaar and DJJ, triggering Rockks to add a face-up Pendulum from your Extra Deck to your hand.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Symphonic Warrior Rockks is a Level 7 Pendulum Synchro that adds a face-up Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck to your hand on summon and during each Standby Phase, and removes 3 Symphonic Counters to destroy an opponent's card.
Draco Berserker of the Tenyi banishes a monster whose effect the opponent activates, and attacks twice after it destroys a monster by battle.
Swordsoul Supreme Sovereign - Chengying gains ATK while debuffing the opponent, protects itself from destruction, and banishes cards from the opponent's field and GY whenever cards are banished.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Symph Amplifire gains a counter on every Symphonic Warrior effect, providing continuous pressure through heavy burn damage or multi-card banishing.
Symphonic Warrior Miccs Special Summons itself from hand by removing 3 Symphonic Counters, and grants an additional Normal Summon of a monster while in the Monster Zone.
Symphonic Warrior Basses modulates Levels by your hand size, enabling exact Synchro calculations for Levels 5 through 10.

allow.Draco Berserker of the Tenyi: Generic Level 8 Synchro for the Symphonic Warrior Tuners; banishes a monster whose effect the opponent activates. Replaces Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon, Forbidden since October 2026.
